readings.Aries: Bold moves suit you. Impulsive ones have a different outcome — know which this is. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Taurus: The people who depend on you know you're reliable. Make sure you know it too. Something is about to become obvious.
readings.Gemini: There is someone in your life who needs your full attention, not your cleverness. Give it to them. This situation responds well to direct engagement.
readings.Cancer: The softness you offer others is not available to you from yourself as often as it should be. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Leo: Rest is not a failure of productivity. For you specifically, this requires repeating. The timing is better than it feels.
readings.Virgo: Your body is communicating something your mind has been too busy to register. Listen. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Libra: There is a relationship in your life that is beautifully curated and increasingly hollow. Look at it. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Scorpio: The secret you're keeping is protecting someone. Including, in some ways, yourself. Trust the slow version of this over the fast one.
readings.Sagittarius: The distance you put between yourself and difficult feelings is getting to be quite a distance. The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Capricorn: The authority you carry was earned. Use it with care today. Make contact with the actual person rather than the version in your head.
readings.Aquarius: Your ability to see the long arc is a gift. Today requires seeing the next five minutes. Someone you haven't thought of lately is relevant to this.
readings.Pisces: The dream you had — not the sleeping one — hasn't been attended to in some time. Return to it. Say the thing you've been rehearsing.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
